title: Five ways to be in the chart
lede: Five channels that kept beating their own usual. Each shape is one channel's ten days; every axis is a share, 0 to 100%.

axes.label: Presence
axes.def: daily readings with a video of the channel in Most Popular

axes.label: Hit rate
axes.def: long uploads ever observed in Most Popular

axes.label: On time
axes.def: uploads within an hour of the channel's usual hour

note: Read it like this: PLAY MAN and NepentheZ 2 are never out of the chart — each new video takes over the channel's one place. Reminex posts like clockwork, but its own videos queue for the same place. Matt Burkeen posts often, at any hour, and lands a few.
src: Our daily readings of YouTube's Most Popular category charts, 27 Sep–6 Oct (10 readings). Long-form uploads from each channel's upload list (live streams and Shorts left out; the list was last refreshed 3–7 Oct, so cadence covers 7–10 days). Usual hour = the median of the channel's upload times. Not a ranking: these are shapes, not scores.
